note: Data of feature 115. spec.md stands where the two differ.

window.opens: the first valid pair after X0 passed
window.closes: 48 valid paired phases or 6 weeks, whichever comes first

experiments.question: Cost accounting: is cost counted for every pass?
experiments.metric: Share of passes whose usage is complete or explicitly unavailable; totals against the harness's own session total
experiments.fixture: Stub agents that emit usage and are killed mid-pass; then 20 live passes, 5 killed on purpose
experiments.rule: 100 per cent of passes accounted for; totals within 2 per cent
experiments.owner: 115 runs it; the counting is of 111

experiments.question: What share of past rejections would a deterministic command have caught?
experiments.metric: Share of rejected and gate-failed attempts whose stated reason a manifest command would have failed
experiments.fixture: Feedback files of past runs; two independent readers
experiments.rule: Below 20 per cent: X5 is run for killed passes and quality only

experiments.question: What does fail-fast save?
experiments.metric: Hours after the first failed step

experiments.question: How much prompt does the obligations index remove?
Why do fresh passes miss the cache?
experiments.cost: None or a few small calls

experiments.question: Does the default configuration meet the targets of decision 21?
experiments.metric: Alive hours per approved phase; passes ended by a time limit or watchdog and runs stopped by the pass limit; first-attempt approval; cost per approved phase
experiments.fixture: The ordinary stratum live; the long stratum by replay and a synthetic job; 50:50
experiments.rule: All four targets of F115-SC-001, or the default returns to classic
experiments.cost: Paid: about 100 h alive and about 1,342 dollars notional per arm

experiments.question: Does the layer itself earn its place?
experiments.fixture: The ordinary stratum; default configuration against the same without the layer

experiments.question: Repair cap and repair context
experiments.metric: Units resolved per minute and per token; share later rejected
experiments.fixture: Unit level; cap 1, 2, 3 by continued against fresh
experiments.rule: A default changes only on a difference larger than the noise at unit level

experiments.question: Unit size and units per pass
experiments.metric: Alive hours per approved phase; share of check time; passes per phase attempt
experiments.fixture: Phases with 10 tasks or more; task against group against phase

experiments.question: Ablation: continuation off
experiments.metric: Cost per pass; minutes to first action
experiments.rule: Continuation stays on only if cost per pass is no worse and first-attempt rejects do not rise
experiments.owner: 115 runs it; the switch is row 10

experiments.question: Ablation: escalation off
experiments.metric: Cost and time per resolved unit; rescue rate; unresolved units
experiments.rule: Escalation stays on only if success per dollar and per hour on the higher tier are no worse than at the base

experiments.question: Ablation: obligations index off
experiments.metric: Input tokens per pass; passes per approved phase
experiments.rule: Off if a guardrail is breached
experiments.owner: 115 runs it; the switch is row 9

experiments.question: Gate integrity and gaming
experiments.metric: (i) output difference with stubs that never declare a unit; (ii) the condition recorded per seeded tampering; (iii) a check that passes half the time; (iv) detection of seeded defects by the critic with and without the fact block
experiments.fixture: Oracle fixtures; seeded features; the tamper fixtures of the owner of the result conditions
experiments.rule: (i) and (ii) block a release; (iii) reported; (iv) wording changes and the test is repeated if detection falls by more than 5 points

experiments.question: Ablation: model-tier bump after K critic rejections
experiments.metric: As X10, at the level of the phase attempt
experiments.rule: Reported to the owner of the option, feature 149
experiments.owner: 115 runs it; the switch is row 24
